patch_description: Replace the anchor ansatz with a more parameter-efficient, gradient-friendly structure that mirrors recent improvements: outer ring entanglement via CRX on the perimeter (crx_ring) and hub-to-edge entanglement via CRY from the center to each edge (cry_hub_edge). This yields 11 learnable parameters per block (vs 10 in some variants) and 66 total parameters for the 3 uploads x 2 repeats setting, aligning with observed gains in validation performance and reduced depth. All other data, training loop, feature map, and measurements remain fixed; only ANSATZ_SPEC (via _build_hierarchical_ansatz_spec) is changed.
